name: KISHKI
source:
The action unfolds in a small town in Russia. You will have to plunge into the life of not quite ordinary Russian student, who recently moved into a dormitory. A story about friendship, hatred and something else awaits you.

[From [url=https://no-father-corporation.itch.io/kishki-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在俄罗斯的一座小镇上。你将深入体验一名刚搬进学生宿舍、不怎么寻常的俄罗斯大学生的日常生活。一段交织着友情、憎恨与某种异样情愫的故事正等待着你。

[摘自[url=https://no-father-corporation.itch.io/kishki-demo]itch.io[/url]]
